_about: PC runner settings (B4100-B4109). train: this runner drives the merge train (B7202; only the Main PC's); trainMinutes, trainMaxHours and sweepUpdates are optional. lanes: the testbed lanes the runner drives, never 1, and not 6 (kept for the local agents since 2026-11-16, B6527). light: jobs that need no lane (book and Trove lookups) run side by side up to this many. Folders use %NAME% from the environment.
_sprites: B6144: Foundry user data folders whose worlds may ask for sprites from inside the game (testbed lanes 2 to 6 only: never lane 1, the owner's own data, and never the Live world), and the Python with numpy and Pillow that runs tools/sprites/batch.py.
